blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed output-rank budget.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作提出了超网络,将一个文档转换成一个低等参数更新(LORA)在一个单一前行通道中,可以快速地将新知识注入被冻结的LLM. 然而,为每个文档存储单独的LORA适配器在流环境中可能是不可持续的. 在本文中,我们研究利用Doc-to-Lora和SHINE这两个代表性系统编组超网络生成的LORA的问题. 我们显示,超网络生成的LORAs的几何学与直接微调的LORAs有很大的不同. 它们的光谱集中度更高,跨文件的对接能力也比下个托肯预测和QA微调适配器更强,这些适配器是分散的,几乎横跨文件的正交. 本着这一看法,我们提议将潜入空间的LORA合并。 我们组成中间超网络潜伏器 然后通过冷冻的LORA生成头解码合并潜伏器 我们显示,潜在空间合并技术在保持单一固定等级适配器的同时,在重量空间和系数空间基线方面不断改进。 这些成果支持潜在的空间构成,作为将超网络产生的LORAs结合到固定产出级预算中的一种有希望的机制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable at using long contexts, but incorporating new information into an LLM remains costly.
A new document can be supplied in the prompt whenever it is needed, but this consumes context length, increases inference cost, and leaves the model’s parameters unchanged.
Alternatively, the document can be distilled into model parameters through fine-tuning ( Gururangan et al., 2020 ; Hu et al., 2022 ; Zweiger et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) or context distillation ( Snell et al., 2022 ) , but this often requires expensive per-document optimization.
Hypernetwork-generated LoRAs ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) offer a different interface for knowledge injection: after a one-time meta-training stage, a hypernetwork maps a document or context into a compact LoRA adapter in a single forward pass, while the base LLM remains frozen. The resulting adapter can then be stored, reused, and activated without placing the original document back into the prompt.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越能够使用长的环境,但将新信息纳入LLM仍然代价高昂。
当需要时,可以立即提供新文件,但这会消耗上下文长度,增加推论成本,使模型的参数保持不变。
或者,该文件可以通过微调(Gurururangan等人,2020年;Hu等人,2022年;Zweiger等人,2025年;Tang等人,2026年)或上下文蒸馏(Snell等人,2022年),但往往需要昂贵的每份文件优化。
超网络生成的LORAs(Charakorn 等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年)为知识注入提供了不同的界面:在一次性元训练阶段后,一个超网络将文档或上下文映射到一个紧凑的LORA适配器中,在一次前传中,而基础LLM仍然冻结. 由此产生的适配器随后可以存储,再利用,并启动,而不将原始文档放回提示中.

blocks.en:
This interface is especially appealing for settings where knowledge arrives as a stream.
For example, a deployed assistant may need to internalize a sequence of news articles, reports, user documents, or database records, and later answer many questions about this accumulated information.
Generating one LoRA per document is a natural first step, but it creates a new composition problem.
Maintaining an ever-growing bank of document adapters is inefficient, query-time routing to a single adapter is insufficient when questions may involve multiple documents, and activating many adapters by concatenation causes the effective rank, memory footprint, and update magnitude to grow with the number of documents.
A practical document-to-LoRA system therefore needs a way to compose multiple generated adapters into a bounded representation.
blocks.zh:
这个界面对于知识作为流流而到达的设置特别有吸引力.
例如,部署的助理可能需要将一系列新闻文章,报告,用户文件,或数据库记录内部化,然后回答关于这种累积信息的许多问题.
每份文件生成一个LORA是自然的第一步,但它造成了一个新的组成问题。
维持一个不断增加的文档适配器库效率低下,当问题可能涉及多个文档时,查询时间到单个适配器的路由不足,通过调和激活许多适配器会导致有效级别,内存足迹,更新数量随着文档数量的增长而增加.
因此,一个实用的文档到LORA系统需要一种方法,将多个生成的适配器编成一个有限度的表示.

blocks.en:
Most existing model-merging methods operate directly in weight space or LoRA factor space, and are usually motivated by adapters obtained through independent gradient-based fine-tuning.
Hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a different origin.
They are not arbitrary endpoints of separate optimization runs; they are outputs of a shared generator, often decoded from an intermediate latent representation.
blocks.zh:
大部分现有的模型合并方法直接在重量空间或LORA因子空间中运行,通常由通过独立的梯度基微调而获得的适配器所激发.
超网络生成 洛拉斯有着不同的起源.
它们不是单独优化运行的任意终点;它们是共享生成器的输出,往往从中间潜在表示中解码。

blocks.en:
In this work, we study this question using two recent hypernetwork-based LoRA systems for knowledge injection, Doc-to-LoRA (D2L) ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ) and SHINE ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
We compare their document-specific adapters against LoRAs obtained by direct next-token prediction fine-tuning and QA supervised fine-tuning on the same passage set.
Figure 1 shows a metric MDS embedding of pairwise adapter distances.
In the two-dimensional MDS embedding, directly fine-tuned adapters form broad shells, while hypernetwork-generated adapters occupy more compact regions, especially for SHINE.
This qualitative picture is confirmed by spectral and angular statistics in Section 3 : hypernetwork-generated adapters exhibit much stronger spectral concentration and substantially larger within-method cosine similarity than directly fine-tuned LoRAs.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们利用最近两个基于超网络的LORA系统来研究这一问题,即Doc-to-LORA(D2L)(Charakorn等人,2026年)和SHINE(Liu等人,2026年)。
我们比较了它们针对文件的适配器与通过直接的下个吻合预测微调和同一段的QA监督微调而获得的LORAs.
图1显示的是双向适配器距离嵌入的度量MDS。
在二维MDS嵌入中,直接微调的适配器形成宽壳,而超网络生成的适配器占据了更紧凑的区域,特别是SHINE.
第3节的光谱和角统计数据证实了这一定性图象:超网络生成的适配器比直接微调的LORAs显示的光谱浓度要强得多,而且方法内余弦相似度要大得多。

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Hypernetwork-generated LoRAs occupy a qualitatively different region of adapter space. We visualize pairwise distances between unit-Frobenius-normalized adapters using metric MDS, with 500 passages per method sampled from the SQuAD validation set.
In the two-dimensional MDS embedding, directly fine-tuned NTP-FT and QA-SFT adapters form broad shells, while D2L and SHINE adapters concentrate in compact regions.
This structural difference motivates latent merging methods that respect the hypernetwork-induced adapter geometry.
blocks.zh:
图1: 超网络生成 LORAs在适应器空间上占据了质的不同区域. 我们使用度量MDS将单位-Frobenius-常态适配器之间的双向距离进行可视化,从SQuAD验证集中抽取每方法500个通道.
在二维MDS嵌入中,直接微调的NTP-FT和QA-SFT适配器组成宽壳,而D2L和SHINE适配器则集中在紧凑区域.
这种结构差异促使潜在的合并方法尊重超网络引起的适配器几何.

blocks.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose Latent Merger, a method to merge hypernetwork-generated LoRAs in the latent space of the hypernetwork rather than in the decoded weight space. Given a set of documents, we extract their frozen hypernetwork latents, compose them with a learned, lightweight merging module, and then pass the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. Latent Merger is trained with the base LLM and the hypernetwork frozen. It produces a single fixed-rank LoRA adapter for the whole document set, rather than increasing rank or storing one adapter per document.
blocks.zh: 基于这一观察,我们提出Latent 合并,一种在超网络潜在空间而不是解码重量空间中合并超网络产生的LORA的方法。 鉴于一系列文件,我们提取它们被冻结的超网络潜伏物, 用一个有学问的轻量级合并模块来组成它们, 然后通过被冻结的LORA生成头通过合并潜伏物。 后期兼并以LLM和超网络冷冻训练. 它为整个文件集生产一个固定等级的LORA适配器,而不是提高等级或存储每个文件一个适配器.

blocks.en:
We evaluate this approach on multi-document QA tuples.
Across both D2L and SHINE, Latent Merger consistently outperforms standard weight-space and factor-space merging methods.
These results suggest that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs should be treated not merely as low-rank weight updates, but as decoded points on a structured adapter manifold whose latent coordinates provide a natural space for composition.
blocks.zh:
我们用多文件的QA Tuple来评价这一方法。
在D2L和SHINE两个方面,Latent兼并一直优于标准权重空间和要素空间合并方法。
这些结果表明,超网络生成的LORA不仅应作为低级重量更新处理,还应作为结构化适配器多面体上的解码点处理,其潜在坐标为组成提供了自然空间。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We empirically characterize the geometry of hypernetwork-generated LoRAs, showing greater spectral concentration and cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters. Metric MDS provides a qualitative visualization of these differences. • We propose Latent Merger, a learned, lightweight latent-space LoRA merging module that composes document latents before decoding them through the frozen hypernetwork head. • We show empirically that Latent Merger outperforms standard weight-space and factor-space merging baselines for multi-document QA while producing a single fixed-rank adapter.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A growing line of work studies parameter-space updates that inject new knowledge into a pre-trained LLM. Earlier approaches include supervised fine-tuning on raw documents, document-specific question-answer pairs, or context distillation ( Askell et al., 2021 ; Mitchell et al., 2021 ; Snell et al., 2022 ; Mitchell et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Qi et al., 2024 ; Shin et al., 2025 ) . These methods enable the model to answer queries without re-reading the original context, but they typically require expensive per-document optimization or synthetic data generation. Hypernetwork-generated LoRAs offer a complementary route by amortizing the update procedure: after meta-training, a single forward pass maps a document ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , task description ( Charakorn et al., 2025 ) , or support set ( Phang et al., 2023 ; Ivison et al., 2023 ) to a compact adapter for a frozen backbone.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作研究参数-空间更新,将新知识注入预先训练的LLM. 早期的方法包括监督对原始文件的微调、文件特定问题回答对或上下文蒸馏(Askell等人,2021年;Mitchell等人,2021年;Snell等人,2022年;Mitchell等人,2022年;Meng等人,2022年;Meng等人,2023年;Qi等人,2024年;Shin等人,2025年)。 这些方法使模型能够在不重读原上下文的情况下回答询问,但它们通常需要昂贵的每份文件优化或合成数据生成. 超网络生成 LoRAs通过摊销更新程序提供了一条补充路线:经过元训练后,一个单一的前进通道地图,一个文件(Charakorn等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年),任务描述(Charakorn等人,2025年),或支持集(Phang等人,2023年;Ivison等人,2023年),一个紧凑的适配器,一个冷冻骨干.

blocks.en: Most relevant to our work, Doc-to-LoRA (D2L) instantiates this idea for document internalization by meta-learning an approximate context-distillation procedure ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ) . It encodes document-conditioned activations from a frozen LLM through a Perceiver-style bottleneck and decodes the resulting latent into LoRA factors, with a chunking mechanism that produces higher-rank adapters for long documents. SHINE ( Liu et al., 2026 ) pursues the same context-to-LoRA goal with a different architecture: it reuses the frozen LLM to extract memory states and applies a Transformer-based memory-to-parameter module whose structure mirrors the target LoRA parameters, enabling communication across layers and memory tokens before decoding the adapter. Our work studies how the document-specific adapters emitted by such hypernetworks can be merged. We use D2L and SHINE as architecturally distinct testbeds, but exploit their shared structure: both generate LoRA weights from an intermediate latent representation that can be more effectively composed than the LoRA weights themselves.
blocks.zh: Doc-to-Lora(D2L)通过学习近似上下文的消化程序,将这一想法作为文件内部化的媒介(Charakorn等人,2026年)。 它通过Perceiver风格的瓶颈,将文件条件化激活从冷冻的LLM中编码,并解码由此产生的潜入LORA因子,其块化机制为长文件产生更高级的适配器. SHINE(Liu et al., 2026)以不同的架构追求相同的上下文对LORA目标:它重用冷冻的LLM来提取内存状态,并应用一个基于变形器的内存对参数模块,其结构反射目标LORA参数,使得在解码适配器之前能够进行跨层和内存符号的通信. 我们的工作研究了如何将这种超网络排放的文档专用适配器合并。 我们使用D2L和SHINE作为建筑上截然不同的试验床,但是利用它们共享的结构:两者都从中间潜在代表物中产生LORA重量,比LORA重量本身更有效组成.

blocks.en: Model merging seeks to combine independently fine-tuned models or adapters without joint retraining. Popular approaches include averaging checkpoints ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ) , combining task vectors through task arithmetic ( Ilharco et al., 2022 ) , or using second-order ( Matena and Raffel, 2022 ) or regression-based ( Jin et al., 2022 ) criteria to form weighted averages. Some recent methods improve robustness by sparsifying updates, resolving sign conflicts, or dropping and rescaling delta weights ( Yadav et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) . These ideas have also been extended to the LoRA setting ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Prabhakar et al., 2025 ) . A complementary line of work exploits LoRA’s low-rank structure more directly, for example by merging in singular-vector or singular-value space ( Gargiulo et al., 2025 ; Stoica et al., 2024 ) , encouraging orthogonal adapter subspaces to reduce interference ( Buyukakyuz, 2024 ; Zhang and Zhou, 2025 ; Xiong and Xie, 2026 ; Cao and Wu, 2026 ) , searching for task-specific linear combination coefficients from a small validation set ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Prabhakar et al., 2025 ) . Some more recent methods also explore training a hypernetwork to predict the merge coefficients ( Shenaj et al., 2025b ) or the merged weights directly ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Also relevant to our work, KMerge ( Shenaj et al., 2025a ) considers budgeted sequential setting and maintains a bounded cache of adapters, merging similar LoRAs when capacity is reached; SLAO ( Qiao and Mahdavi, 2025 ) continually folds new adapters into a single LoRA with orthogonal initialization and time-aware scaling.
blocks.zh: 模型合并寻求将独立微调的模型或适配器合并而无需联合再培训. 流行的方法包括平均检查站(Wortsman等人,2022年),通过任务算术(Ilharco等人,2022年)或使用二顺序(Matena and Raffel,2022年)或回归(Jin等人,2022年)标准合并任务矢量,形成加权平均值. 最近的一些方法通过刷新更新、解决标志冲突或降低和调整三角洲的重量来提高强度(Yadav等人,2023年;Yu等人,2024年)。 这些想法还扩展到了Lora环境(Huang等人,2023年;Prabhakar等人,2025年)。 一个互补的工作线更直接地利用了LORA的低级结构,例如通过在单向或单值空间的合并(Gargiulo等人,2025年;Stoica等人,2024年),鼓励正向适配子空间减少干扰(Buukakyuz,2024年;张和周,2025年;Xiong和Xie,2026年;曹和吴,2026年),从一个小型验证组中寻找特定任务线性组合系数(Huang等人,2023年;Prabhakar等人,2025年)。 一些较新的方法也探索培训一个超网络,以预测合并系数(Shenaj等人,2025年b)或直接合并加权数(Zhang等人,2025年)。 与我们的工作同样相关的是,Kmerge(Shenaj等人,2025年a)考虑预算的顺序设置,并维持一个有限的适配器缓存,在达到容量时将类似的LORA合并;SLAO(Qiao和Mahdavi,2025年)不断将新的适配器折叠成一个具有正向初始化和时间感知的单LORA.

blocks.en: In contrast to these prior methods that operate in the weight or factor space, our method exploits the fact that each adapter is decoded by a frozen hypernetwork from a structured intermediate representation, and merges in this latent representation space directly. The merged latent code is then decoded through the frozen hypernetwork into the final LoRA. This latent-space formulation supports both training-free operators, such as averaging, and learned operators, such as a lightweight Transformer trained on document mixtures.
blocks.zh: 与这些在重量或因数空间中运行的先前的方法不同,我们的方法利用每个适配器由一个结构化中间代表的冷冻超网络解码,并直接在这个潜在代表空间中合并. 合并后的潜在代码通过冻结的超网络解码为最终的LORA. 这种潜在的空间配方既支持无培训操作人员,如平均操作人员,也支持有知识操作人员,如受过文件混合物培训的轻量级变压器。

blocks.en: Related work in image generation studies operations on intermediate representations: StyleGAN mixes styles derived from learned latent codes ( Karras et al., 2019 ) . Composable diffusion models combine conditional score estimates to compose visual concepts ( Liu et al., 2022 ) . In this work, we present a lightweight learned composition rule for hypernetwork-generated LLM adapters under an output-rank budget.
blocks.zh: 图像生成方面的相关工作: StyleGAN混合了从学到的潜在代码中衍生出来的风格(Karras等人,2019年). 可编译的传播模型结合了有条件的分数估计来组成视觉概念(Liu等人,2022年). 在这项工作中,我们提出了一种轻量级的学习成份规则,用于超网络生成的LLM适配器,用的是产出排名预算.

Figure 2 shows that hypernetwork-generated adapters are substantially more spectrally concentrated than directly fine-tuned adapters.
For both backbones, the spectral energy curve of the hypernetwork method lies far above the corresponding NTP-FT and QA-SFT curves, indicating that a small number of global directions explain a much larger fraction of the uncentered spectral energy.

The angular statistics reveal the same qualitative distinction.
As shown in Table 1 , directly fine-tuned adapters have near-zero within-method cosine similarity, meaning that different passage-specific updates are almost orthogonal after unit-Frobenius normalization.
By contrast, D2L adapters are more aligned with one another, and SHINE adapters are highly aligned.
This shows that the spectral concentration above is not only a consequence of scale: even after normalizing each adapter to unit Frobenius norm, hypernetwork-generated adapters retain a much stronger shared direction than adapters obtained by direct fine-tuning.
The Frobenius norms in Table 1 further show that the generated adapters also differ in magnitude from the fine-tuned controls, motivating our use of normalized cosine and distance metrics when comparing geometry.

blocks.en:
This structural difference has direct implications for adapter merging.
If per-document LoRAs are nearly orthogonal, weight-space averaging attenuates each document-specific contribution, while concatenation retains the individual factors at a larger representation size.
Hypernetwork-generated adapters exhibit stronger cross-document alignment and are decoded from latent representations by a shared generator.
This shared parameterization motivates composing document representations before decoding them through the frozen hypernetwork head.

这种结构差异直接影响到适配器的合并.
如果每个文件的LORA几乎是正交的,则平均权重空间会减轻每个文件的具体贡献,而结合则保留较大的代表大小的个别因素。
超网络生成的适配器显示较强的跨文件对齐,并且从共享生成器的潜在表示解码.
这种共享参数化在解码文档表达式之前,会通过被冻结的超网络头来激发其编译功能.

blocks.en: 4 Merging Hypernetwork-generated LoRAs
blocks.zh: 4 合并超网络生成的 LORA

blocks.en: We now study whether multiple document-specific hypernetwork LoRAs can be composed into a single adapter. Each evaluation example consists of a tuple of N N passages and their associated questions. A merger receives the adapters, or the corresponding hypernetwork latents, for all N N passages and must produce one LoRA dictionary shared across the whole tuple. At inference time, the model answers each question using this single merged adapter, without access to the original document in the context or the document-specific oracle adapter.
blocks.zh: 我们现在研究能否将多个文档专用的超网络LORA组成一个单一的适配器. 每个评价实例包括一连串NN段及其相关问题。 合并接收NN所有段落的适配器或相应的超网络潜伏器,必须制作一个LORA字典,在整个Tuple中共享。 在推论时间,模型使用这个单一的合并适配器回答每个问题,无法在上下文中访问原始文档或特定文档的甲骨文适配器.

blocks.en: 4.1 Proposed Method: Learned Latent Merger
blocks.zh: 4.1 拟议方法:吸取的后期合并

blocks.en: Our hypothesis is that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs are easier to compose in the latent space than directly in the LoRA weight space. We therefore train Latent Merger, a lightweight cross-document merging module that composes multiple document-specific hypernetwork latents before the frozen LoRA-generation head. Figure 3 summarizes the approach.
blocks.zh: 我们的假设是,超网络生成的LORA在潜伏空间比直接在LORA重量空间更容易构成. 因此,我们训练Latent合并,一个轻量级交叉文件合并模块,在冷冻的LORA生成头之前,由多个文件特定的超网络潜伏组成. 图3概述了这一办法。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Latent Merger overview. A shared, frozen hypernetwork encoder maps each document to a latent. The trainable merger adds a gated, permutation-invariant residual to the latent mean. The frozen LoRA-generation head decodes the merged latent into one fixed-rank adapter for the frozen language model.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Setup and Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验设置和基线

blocks.en:
We train Latent Merger on the SQuAD training split ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) . Both D2L and SHINE use the same merger training data. At each training step, we sample the tuple size uniformly as N ∼ Uniform ​ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } N\sim\mathrm{Uniform}\{2,3,4,5\} .
We then sample N N distinct passages uniformly from the SQuAD training split. For each selected passage, we sample one question uniformly from that passage’s associated question list. Thus, each training tuple contains N N passages and one question-answer pair per passage.

我们训练Latent Merger进行SQAD训练分拆(Rajpurkar等人,2016年). D2L和SHINE都使用相同的合并培训数据. 在每一个训练步骤上,我们用N\\ uniform { 2, 3, 4, 5}来统一抽取TUPL的大小。 N\sim\ mathrm{ Uniform {2, 4, 5} 。

blocks.en: For the main experiments, we use pretrained generator checkpoints for Gemma-2-2B-it (D2L) and Qwen3-8B (SHINE). For D2L, we merge the post-ResMLP hypernetwork latents and pass the merged latent through the frozen normalization and LoRA-generation head. For SHINE, we apply the same Latent Merger architecture to the Qwen3-8B memory-state latents and pass the merged memory state through the frozen metanetwork. In both cases, the base LM, hypernetwork trunk, and LoRA-generation head remain frozen; only Latent Merger parameters are optimized. Each merger is trained for the latent representation and decoding head of its corresponding generator checkpoint.

This isolates the effect of rank expansion from the magnitude growth induced by unscaled concatenation. • Norm-preserving rank concatenation: We again concatenate all rank components, but rescale the resulting update to match the average Frobenius norm of the individual document adapters: Δ ​ W merge = γ ​ ∑ i = 1 N Δ ​ W i , γ = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N ‖ Δ ​ W i ‖ F ‖ ∑ i = 1 N Δ ​ W i ‖ F + ϵ . \Delta W_{\mathrm{merge}}=\gamma\sum_{i=1}^{N}\Delta W_{i},\qquad\gamma=\frac{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\|\Delta W_{i}\|_{F}}{\left\|\sum_{i=1}^{N}\Delta W_{i}\right\|_{F}+\epsilon}. This baseline preserves the full rank-expanded subspace while controlling for the scale mismatch introduced by summing multiple LoRA updates. • Factor averaging: We average the LoRA factors directly, A avg = 1 N ​ ∑ i A i A_{\mathrm{avg}}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}A_{i} , B avg = 1 N ​ ∑ i B i B_{\mathrm{avg}}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}B_{i} .
This keeps the adapter rank fixed at r r , but averages the factorization rather than the induced weight update, and is therefore not equivalent to averaging Δ ​ W i \Delta W_{i} in weight space. • SVD-compressed weight averaging: We first compute the mean dense update Δ ​ W ¯ = 1 N ​ ∑ i Δ ​ W i \bar{\Delta W}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i}\Delta W_{i} ,
then take its best rank- r r truncated SVD approximation and refactorize it into LoRA form. This provides a strong fixed-rank weight-space baseline for compressing the average update back to the original LoRA rank. • TIES: We adapt TIES ( Yadav et al., 2023 ) to the LoRA setting by applying magnitude trimming, majority-sign election, and sign-consistent merging to the aligned adapter tensors, followed by mean-scaled rank concatenation to materialize the merged LoRA dictionary. For D2L, we average the post-ResMLP latents and pass the result through the frozen normalization and LoRA-generation head; for SHINE, we average the memory states and pass the result through the frozen metanetwork. This is the direct training-free counterpart of our proposed Latent Merger and isolates the benefit of learning a nontrivial set function over document latents.

blocks.en: Latent Merger achieves the strongest overall composition performance across both hypernetwork settings. For D2L, it obtains the best or tied-best mean performance for every evaluated value of N N on both SQuAD and MS MARCO. For SHINE, it similarly leads on all SQuAD settings and on MS MARCO for N = 2 N=2 and N = 5 N=5 , while remaining essentially competitive with the best method in the most challenging N = 10 N=10 OOD setting. These results indicate that the learned latent-space composition rule provides a robust advantage over direct weight-, factor-, and rank-space composition strategies.
blocks.zh: 后期兼并在两种超网络设置中实现了最强的整体构成性能. 就D2L而言,它在SQuAD和MS MARCO上都获得了NN每个评价值的最佳或捆绑平均性能. 对SHINE来说,它同样领先于所有SQuAD设置和MS MARCO的N=2N=2和N=5N=5,同时在最具挑战性的N=10N=10OOD设置中基本上保持与最佳方法的竞争. 这些结果表明,所学到的潜在空间构成规则比直接权重、因数和等级空间构成战略提供了强大的优势。

blocks.en: In the main experiments, Latent Merger is trained only on SQuAD tuples with N N sampled from { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } \{2,3,4,5\} , yet the evaluation probes two forms of generalization: extrapolation to larger compositions and transfer to an out-of-domain dataset. The method remains the strongest approach when extrapolated to N = 10 N=10 on SQuAD for both D2L and SHINE, suggesting that the learned merger does not merely memorize the training cardinalities. It also transfers well to MS MARCO, consistently matching or exceeding competing approaches except in the most OOD SHINE setting, where its performance is nearly indistinguishable from the best baseline. This suggests that latent composition captures structure that is not specific to the SQuAD training distribution.
blocks.zh: 在主要实验中,Latent Merger只接受了关于SQuAD tuple的培训,N的样本来自{2,3,4,5} {2,3,4,5},然而评价探究了两种概括形式:外推到更大的成分和转移到一个域外数据集. 这种方法仍然是D2L和SHINE在SQuAD上推算为N=10N=10时最强的方法,说明所学的合并并不只是记住培训要点。 该系统还很好地向MS MARCO转让,始终匹配或超越了相互竞争的方法,但OOD SHINE环境除外,其性能与最佳基线几乎无法区分。 这表明,潜在的构成可以捕捉并非SQAD培训分配特有的结构。

blocks.en: Rank concatenation provides a larger effective LoRA rank than the other composition methods, and might therefore be expected to preserve more task-specific information. Surprisingly, this additional capacity does not translate into reliable performance. This is especially notable for D2L, where the training procedure already encourages concatenation-like composition by chunking documents and composing the resulting LoRAs. Across both D2L and SHINE, however, none of the unscaled, 1 / N 1/N -scaled, or norm-preserving concatenation variants is consistently competitive across all values of N N . The results suggest that simply increasing rank does not solve the composition problem: unscaled concatenation becomes unstable as more LoRAs are added, whereas aggressive scaling weakens the contribution of each individual LoRA.
blocks.zh: 与其它组成方法相比,等级合并提供了更大的有效LORA等级,因此,可以预期能够保存更多的具体任务信息。 令人惊讶的是,这种额外能力并没有转化为可靠的业绩。 这一点在D2L方面尤其突出,在那里,培训程序已经通过对文件进行块块化和编组所产生的LORA,鼓励类似Concateation的构成。 然而,在D2L和SHINE中,没有一种未标定的、1 / N 1/N - 标定的或规范-保温变体在NN的所有值上都是一致竞争的。 结果表明,仅仅提高军衔并不能解决构成问题:由于添加了更多的LORA,未分级的凝结变得不稳定,而积极的缩放则削弱了每个个人LORA的贡献.

blocks.en: The comparison between latent-space methods and weight- or factor-space baselines supports the central hypothesis that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs are easier to compose before they are decoded into LoRA factors. Even the training-free Latent Average baseline is highly competitive and often outperforms direct factor averaging, SVD compression, TIES, and DARE. Latent Merger further improves upon this by learning a composition function in the hypernetwork latent space, yielding the most consistent gains across datasets, composition sizes, and hypernetwork backbones. This pattern indicates that the latent representation provides a smoother and more semantically aligned space for merging than the induced LoRA weight space itself.
blocks.zh: 潜在空间方法与权重或因数空间基线的比较支持了中心假设,即超网络生成的LORA在解码成LORA因子之前更容易形成. 即使是无训练的Lateent平均基线也具有高度的竞争力,而且往往超过直接平均系数、SVD压缩、TIES和DERE。 通过在超网络潜在空间学习一个组成功能,在数据集、组成大小和超网络主干线之间产生最一致的收益,Lateent兼并进一步改善了这方面的情况。 这种模式表明,潜在代表比诱导的LORA重量空间本身更平滑、更一致地进行合并。

Training the merger on an XSum+2Wiki+MMLU mixture with an in-context teacher that reads both source documents for 2Wiki examples increases judge accuracy from 36.0 % 36.0\% to 42.0 % 42.0\% , an absolute gain of 6.0 6.0 percentage points. The SQuAD-trained merger does not improve over latent averaging in this evaluation.

blocks.en: In addition to the knowledge distillation KL-divergence objective that we used to train Latent Merger, using the cross-entropy loss on the ground truth answers as in standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is also a natural choice. We compare KL divergence and cross-entropy as the training objective for Latent Merger training in Table 5 . We observe that the KL loss consistently outperforms the CE loss across all values of N N on both D2L and SHINE. The results suggest that matching the full output distribution provides a more reliable training signal than optimizing only the ground-truth answer likelihood. Overall, these results indicate that KL loss is the preferable objective for training Latent Merger.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: In this work, we study the geometry and composition of hypernetwork-generated LoRA adapters. Across two representative systems, D2L and SHINE, we find that generated document adapters differ sharply from LoRAs obtained by direct fine-tuning. While NTP-FT and QA-SFT adapters are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents, hypernetwork-generated adapters are much more spectrally concentrated and occupy compact regions of adapter space. These results suggest that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs should not be treated simply as ordinary low-rank weight updates, but as decoded points on a structured adapter manifold induced by the shared generator.
blocks.zh: 在这个作品中,我们研究了超网络生成的LORA适配器的几何学和组成. 通过D2L和SHINE这两个具有代表性的系统,我们发现产生的文件适配器与直接微调得到的LORA大不相同。 虽然NTP-FT和QA-SFT适配器是分散的,并且几乎横跨文件,但超网络生成适配器的光谱集中程度更高,占据适配器空间的紧凑区域。 这些结果表明,超网络生成的LORA不应简单地作为普通的低等级重量更新处理,而应作为共享生成器诱导的结构化适配器多重上的解码点处理.

blocks.en: This structural difference directly motivates our merging method. Instead of composing adapters after they have been decoded into LoRA weights or factors, we merge their intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged representation through the frozen LoRA-generation head. Both latent averaging and Latent Merger outperform standard weight-space and factor-space baselines across D2L and SHINE, while producing a single fixed-rank adapter. The learned merger further improves over latent averaging, showing that a lightweight permutation-invariant set function can capture useful cross-document corrections without modifying the base LLM or the original hypernetwork. These findings suggest that latent-space composition can be a promising mechanism for bounded accumulation of hypernetwork-generated document adapters.
blocks.zh: 这种结构差异直接推动了我们的合并方法。 与其在适配器解码成LORA重量或因子后编组,我们合并了它们的中间超网络潜伏物,然后通过冷冻的LORA生成头解码合并代表物. 潜在平均和Latent合并都超过了D2L和SHINE标准重量空间和系数空间基线,同时产生一个单一的固定等级适配器。 所学的兼并进一步改善了超潜在平均率,表明轻量级的穿透-内变函数集可以捕捉有用的跨文件校正,而无需修改基础LLM或原超网络. 这些研究结果表明,潜在的空间构成可以成为限量积累超网络生成的文件适配器的一种有希望的机制。

blocks.en: Our reported composition evaluations cover QA, while non-QA generalization and resolution of conflicting sources remain untested. Our experiments primarily evaluate composing multiple LoRAs into a single fixed-rank LoRA adapter, which can become a capacity bottleneck as more documents are merged. A natural next step is to combine latent merging with adaptive rank allocation, retrieval over merged adapter banks, and online memory-management policies that decide when to merge, retain, or discard document adapters in a streaming setting.
blocks.zh: 我们报告的构成评估涉及质量保证,而非质量保证的概括和冲突来源的解决仍未经过测试。 我们的实验主要评价多个LORA组装成一个固定等级的LORA适配器,随着更多文件的合并,它会成为一个容量瓶颈. 下一个自然步骤是将潜在的合并与适应性等级分配、对合并的适配器库进行检索以及在线内存管理政策结合起来,这些政策决定何时合并、保留或丢弃在流媒体环境中的文件适配器。

blocks.en: Appendix E Broader impacts
blocks.zh: 附录E 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: We study how to combine document knowledge in hypernetwork-generated adapters while keeping the base language model fixed. Composing several document adapters into one fixed-rank adapter could make document-based language systems more accessible under limited storage budgets. However, adapters may encode inaccurate, biased, or sensitive content from their source documents, and our results show capacity limits as more documents are combined. Merging document representations may also make source attribution and selective removal of information more difficult, although we do not evaluate these properties.
blocks.zh: 我们研究如何在超网络生成的适配器中结合文档知识,同时保持基础语言模型的固定. 将几个文件适配器编成一个固定等级的适配器可使基于文件的语言系统在有限的存储预算下更容易访问. 然而,适配器可能会从源文件中编码不准确,偏颇或敏感的内容,我们的结果显示,随着更多文件的合并,容量是有限的. 合并文件表述还可能使来源归属和选择性删除信息更加困难,尽管我们不评估这些属性。
